title: COMPREHENSIVE ASSESSMENT OF NUTRIENT ENRICHMENT IN VERMICOMPOST DERIVED SOLELY FROM BANANA PSEUDO STEM WASTE
issuer: International Journal of Scientific Research, volume 14, issue 11

evidence_locators.scope: Issue/date, title, credits, experimental design and methods.
Nutrient table, discussion, conclusion and references.

title: EVALUATION OF BANANA PSEUDOSTEM (BPS) FERMENTED WITH YEAST AS AN ALTERNATIVE FEED INGREDIENT ON EGG WEIGHT AND QUALITY IN BV300 LAYING HENS
issuer: Global Journal for Research Analysis, volume 15, issue 7

evidence_locators.scope: Title, credits, issue date and preparation-method start.
Fermentation, eight-hen/seven-day design, HPLC figures and day-level egg-weight table.

method_summary: Describes boiling, grinding, yeast fermentation and drying, then a seven-day feed comparison involving eight hens. Includes nutrient/HPLC figures and daily egg weights.
evidence_limits: Table 2 gives one value per group/day, without hen-level observations. Its seven experimental values average 77.43 g, matching Figure 2 but differing from the printed 76.57 g summary. Significance and feed efficacy remain source claims, without independent replication or exhibition linkage.

title: Seasonal microplastic dynamics in the Alappuzha–Changanacherry Canal, Kerala, India
issuer: Discover Water, volume 6, article 123; Springer Nature

affiliations_as_published_in_pdf.affiliation_as_published: Alphonsa College, Pala, Kottayam, Kerala, India

evidence_locators.scope: Title, author credits and college affiliation.
Morphology and polymer ranges corresponding to the compendium.

method_summary: Compares seasonal canal-water samples using peroxide digestion, filtration, stereomicroscopy and micro-Raman polymer identification.
evidence_limits: No exhibition reference; college affiliation and three-author credit differ. Publication follows the fair. Author-contribution declarations are not independently verified and cannot be transferred to the exhibition credit. The abstract/body particle-size units differ, reported percentage denominators need clarification, and the compendium has a materials/procedure reagent difference. Matching text does not validate these measurements.
